task: Zaporizhzhia explosion enrichment Slice 0B hardened rerun

methodology.rerun_execution: Existing 36 Slice0 source-hit episode evidence chains were rechecked under hardened attribution rules. All 135 prior no_source_hit episodes were independently re-queried with a city+date+episode-local-window search. The four previous control-recall failures also received the reusable fallback routes defined in the hardening artifact.
methodology.publication_time_rule: Publication time is never event time.
methodology.multi_episode_rule: Every episode on a multi-episode date is searched separately; finding one event never closes the date.
methodology.pvo_rule: PVO_ONLY remains non-strict; PVO_PLUS_EXPLOSION and PVO_CHAIN_SUPPORT require exact-city explosion/impact plus episode-specific chronology.

false_positive_guard_examples.observed_hit: Police/OVA article published 07:38 about a UAV strike around 04:45-04:50.
false_positive_guard_examples.protected_from: Wrong attribution to the 07:35-08:18 no-hit episode.
false_positive_guard_examples.disposition: Event time points back to the already-known near-boundary sensitivity episode; publication time ignored.

false_positive_guard_examples.observed_hit: Later reports describe the city attack with explicit 18:08-18:24 attack interval.
false_positive_guard_examples.protected_from: Spreading the same attack into later 18:33/19:44/20:47/23:26 alerts.
false_positive_guard_examples.disposition: Retained with the already-known canonical strict episode covering 18:08-18:24.
Belongs to the cross-midnight positive-control alert that began 21:20.

false_positive_guard_examples.observed_hit: A later publication on 21 November described an explicit event at 22:10 on 20 November.
false_positive_guard_examples.disposition: Excluded from 21 November episodes by explicit event time.

false_positive_guard_examples.observed_hit: Police article published 00:01 on 17 June about the continuing Shahed attack.
false_positive_guard_examples.protected_from: Using 00:01 publication time as a new next-day event.
false_positive_guard_examples.disposition: Used only as corroboration for the contemporaneous 19:51-20:02 Telegram chain.

precision_regression_check.conclusion: Hardening increased positive-control discovery recall without changing any Slice0 episode verdict or adding a new strict/sensitivity candidate. Raw widened hits were rejected when event time, locality, PVO-only status, or attack chronology did not support the target episode.

verdict: SLICE 0 DISCOVERY PIPELINE READY FOR CHRONOLOGICAL SCALE-UP
